text: AI stacks are getting powerful fast. Agent teams, video generators, coding agents and multi-model workflows can all be useful — but every new tool adds another owner, renewal, permission set and cost line. The operating question is no longer ‘what AI can we add?’ It is ‘which tools earn a clear place in a real workflow?’ Start with the free 12-question stack audit.

The useful question is not ‘which AI tool is best?’ It is ‘where is the workflow leaking?’ Ownership, handoffs, duplicate tools, weak evidence and no fallback are operating problems before they are model problems. The Live Lab lets you choose the problem first and jump into the relevant diagnostic or system map instead of browsing a catalog.

AI video is moving from ‘generate one clip’ to a production system: signal → angle → script → visual progression → audio → rights QA → platform routing → measurement. The advantage is not another prompt. It is a reusable production loop. Explore the Trend-to-Video system if your AI videos still feel like disconnected scenes or moving slides.

A tool can be impressive and still fail the budget test. Finance needs a visible chain: current workflow → cost → expected value → human review → uncertainty → go / hold threshold. If the decision can be owned internally, the $39 AI Value Realization Kit is the self-service middle step before a higher-touch audit.

Architecture should be inspectable, not buried in a sales page. Stratum Praxis Live Lab maps signal → diagnosis → decision → execution → measurement, then lets you route into cost, workflow, agent, revenue or video demos. Use it to inspect the operating path before adding another AI tool.
